definitions.explanation: A sport played between two teams of eleven players using a spherical ball, where players try to score by kicking the ball into the opposing goal.

examples.japanese: サッカーの{俄|にわか}ファンが{増|ふ}えた。
examples.english: The number of bandwagon soccer fans increased.

examples.japanese: サッカーを{見|み}るのが{好|す}きだ。
{子供|こども}の{頃|ころ}からサッカーをしている。
examples.english: I've been playing soccer since I was a child.

examples.japanese: サッカー{日本代表|にほんだいひょう}を{応援|おうえん}する。
examples.english: To support the Japanese national soccer team.

notes:
From English "soccer."

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
・サッカーをする (to play soccer)
・サッカーを{見|み}る (to watch soccer)
・サッカー{選手|せんしゅ} (soccer player)
・サッカーボール (soccer ball)
・サッカー{日本代表|にほんだいひょう} (Japan national soccer team)
・ワールドカップ (World Cup)

CULTURAL NOTE:
In Japanese, サッカー (from American English "soccer") is used rather than フットボール (football), which typically refers to American football in Japan.
